summary: Restore the hen, kurk-, in the first animal mention
rationale: JL 13.11/10 reads fayišina ʕaǧēbmayi mi=kurkaṯe: they marvel at the hen. The entry substitutes f for k, changing hen into snake, while its translation still says Henne. The later i=kurf-aṯe in the same sentence correctly refers to the snake and must be retained. Verses 8–9 also distinguish kurke (hen) from kurfo (snake).
Geschichten is a German noun and is capitalized in the cited edition. Its lowercase initial is a typo.
